title: Lesson Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lesson:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often lesson metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on lesson metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back how often your lesson metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
